main.description: The governance envelope for a lifeline-commons funding proposal (ADR-2606272200). iriai PROPOSES; the commons (1 SBT = 1 vote) DECIDES; the producer actor (under Council) ACTS. Compute-only R0: the decision stops at :intent — the live act (energize/flow/ignite/activate) is the producer cell under Council Lv7+ + operator-DID + member signature (G5, §1.12 Transparent-Force). no-server-key: iriai holds no key; writes are member-CACAO-attributed (G6).

governance.description: PublicFundGovernance: 20% quorum / 50% of cast / 7-day vote / 48h timelock

councilAttestation.description: Council attestation level (= PR review in bootstrap); critical-infra (electric/water) provision escalates to Lv7+ (Transparent-Force §1.12)

actuationClass.description: G5 — compute-only R0; iriai stops at :intent; live actuation is the producer cell under Council Lv7+ + operator-DID + member-sig

liveActuationGate.description: the gate the live act must pass (producer-cell + council-lv7+ + operator-did + member-sig)

serverHeldKey.description: G6 — no-server-key; iriai holds no signing key

attribution.description: autonomous writes attributed to a consenting member via a revocable CACAO leash (ADR-2606111400)

advisory.description: G3 — iriai never unilaterally decides or dispatches
